name: bun-caddy-sqlite
description: Bun service + Caddy + SQLite (local file or Turso), published at a Moshpit name over IPv6

vars.MOSHPIT_NAME: the registered name to serve, e.g. foo.whatever
vars.TURSO_DATABASE_URL: libsql:// URL for a hosted database; omit to use a local file
vars.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN: token for the Turso database, required when the URL is remote
